show_text.name: Show text
show_text.description: Shows text on the fan, sized to fit the round display, optionally with an icon, a ready-made style and a colour that follows a value.

device_id.name: Fans
device_id.description: Fans to show it on (empty: all).

text.name: Text
text.description: The text; a new line starts a new line. Optional with an icon or style (the clock style shows the current time).

font_size.name: Maximum font size
font_size.description: Cap in pixels (0: as large as fits).

show_seconds.name: Duration
show_seconds.description: A message: shown this many seconds, the fan repeats only this meanwhile and then returns to what it played; a fan that was off goes off again. 0: keep (live: 10 s).

priority.name: Priority
priority.description: For a message with a duration: a lower one waits until the one showing is done, a higher one interrupts it (that one comes back afterwards). Default 0.

mode.name: Mode
mode.description: Store on the fan, or show live without storing.

name.name: File name
name.description: Name on the fan; the same name replaces the earlier file.

style.name: Style
style.description: Ready-made look with colours, icon and a ring along the rim.

icon.name: Icon
icon.description: Icon above the text (or alone), e.g. mdi:washing-machine.

value.name: Value
value.description: Colours the text from green (at the minimum) via yellow to red (at the maximum).

invert_colors.name: Reverse colours
invert_colors.description: Red at the minimum and green at the maximum.

gauge.name: Meter ring
gauge.description: A ring along the rim filled like a meter, from value_min to value_max.

ring.name: Ring
ring.description: Coloured ring along the rim (styles have one already).

icon_color.name: Icon colour
icon_color.description: Colour of the icon (default: from the style or the text).

show_image.name: Show picture
show_image.description: Shows a picture, an animated GIF or a video on the fan.

device_id.name: Fans
device_id.description: Fans to show it on (empty: all).

path.name: File
path.description: Path of a picture, GIF or video on Home Assistant, in a folder of allowlist_external_dirs (e.g. /media/…).

url.name: URL
url.description: Picture, GIF or video to download.

camera.name: Camera
camera.description: Show a snapshot of this camera.

media.name: Media
media.description: Picture, GIF or video from the media library.

text.name: Text
text.description: Text written over the picture (over every frame of an animation), e.g. "Rain in 15 minutes" over a rain radar; the picture is darkened behind the letters.

font_size.name: Maximum font size
font_size.description: Cap in pixels (0: as large as fits).

show_seconds.name: Duration
show_seconds.description: A message: shown this many seconds, the fan repeats only this meanwhile and then returns to what it played; a fan that was off goes off again. 0: keep (live: 10 s).

priority.name: Priority
priority.description: For a message with a duration: a lower one waits until the one showing is done, a higher one interrupts it (that one comes back afterwards). Default 0.

mode.name: Mode
mode.description: Store on the fan, or show live without storing.

name.name: File name
name.description: Name on the fan; the same name replaces the earlier file.

max_frames.name: Maximum frames
max_frames.description: At most this many frames of a GIF or video (default 100 for video, 200 for GIF).

fps.name: Frames per second
fps.description: For videos: frames taken per second (default 10).

show_ai.name: Show AI picture
show_ai.description: Has an AI draw a picture (ComfyUI in your house, or a Home Assistant AI Task such as Google) and shows it on the fan, still or turning round its own axis. Needs the P56 add-on.

device_id.name: Fans
device_id.description: Fans to show it on (empty: all).

prompt.name: Prompt
prompt.description: What to draw. A black background and a bold, centred subject are asked for by themselves.

kind.name: Kind
kind.description: A still picture, or the object turning round its own axis (as on a turntable).

art_style.name: Style
art_style.description: How it is drawn: a ready-made style, or type your own (e.g. Van Gogh). Empty: as the prompt says.

entity_id.name: AI Task
entity_id.description: Which AI makes the picture. Empty: ComfyUI when it is set up in the add-on (ComfyUI address), otherwise the first AI Task that can; when ComfyUI cannot be reached the AI Task takes over. Only ComfyUI: switch to YAML and enter comfyui.

text.name: Text
text.description: Text written over the picture, e.g. a price or a notification. The AI then makes a whole picture of the prompt as background (without writing), and the text goes over it on a darkened band. Kind is ignored then.

color.name: Text colour
color.description: Colour of the text (a name, #rrggbb or r,g,b).

icon.name: Icon
icon.description: Icon over the AI picture, only without text; with text only the text is shown.

value.name: Value
value.description: Colour the text by this value: green at the minimum, red at the maximum.

invert_colors.name: Reverse colours
invert_colors.description: Red at the minimum and green at the maximum.

gauge.name: Meter ring
gauge.description: A ring along the rim filled like a meter, from value_min to value_max.

font_size.name: Font size
font_size.description: Largest letter size in pixels (0: as large as fits).

fresh.name: New picture
fresh.description: Always have a new picture made; otherwise the same prompt reuses the picture made before (saves cost).

show_seconds.name: Duration
show_seconds.description: A message: shown this many seconds, the fan repeats only this meanwhile and then returns to what it played; a fan that was off goes off again. 0: keep (live: 10 s).

priority.name: Priority
priority.description: For a message with a duration: a lower one waits until the one showing is done, a higher one interrupts it (that one comes back afterwards). Default 0.

mode.name: Mode
mode.description: Store on the fan, or show live without storing.

name.name: File name
name.description: Name on the fan; the same name replaces the earlier file.

play_file.name: Play file
play_file.description: Plays a file on the fan, by slot or name.

delete_file.name: Delete file
delete_file.description: Deletes a file from the fan, by slot or name.
